name: noet-ui-assets
description: UI dependencies for noet-core HTML viewer

scripts.install:vendor: npm install && npm run copy:open-props && npm run copy:katex && npm run copy:tabulator
scripts.copy:open-props: mkdir -p open-props && cp node_modules/open-props/open-props.min.css open-props/ && cp node_modules/open-props/normalize.min.css open-props/
scripts.copy:katex: mkdir -p katex/fonts && cp node_modules/katex/dist/katex.min.css katex/ && cp node_modules/katex/dist/katex.min.js katex/ && cp node_modules/katex/dist/contrib/auto-render.min.js katex/ && cp node_modules/katex/dist/fonts/* katex/fonts/
scripts.copy:tabulator: mkdir -p tabulator && cp node_modules/tabulator-tables/dist/css/tabulator.min.css tabulator/ && cp node_modules/tabulator-tables/dist/js/tabulator.min.js tabulator/
